semantic_scope_witness.statement: If an artifact digest is computed from an artifact payload that excludes external source metadata, changing only that external metadata leaves the artifact digest unchanged; including a canonical source-provenance block in the digest makes the same mutation detectable.

On load or downstream consumption, recompute and fail closed on any mutation of that bound provenance block rather than trusting report text alone.
Preserve the distinction between corrected-reader provenance binding and independent verification of original-paper exact correspondence.
Do not infer visual correspondence, PDE validity, paper exactness or OpenAI-field identity from provenance closure.
